comment: SPEED is asymmetric in a way the maker's own comment and QUICKSTART.md contradict: dsp/tapestry-core.h:383-398 raises 2 to the power of semitones/12 for both directions, so the reverse end of the knob plays backwards at about 4.5 times speed rather than the 26 semitones down that kVariSpeedDownSemitones and the manual describe. QUICKSTART.md also says centre is normal forward playback; the code has a dead zone of 0.02 either side of centre that stops playback outright (dsp/tapestry-core.h:368-377), and the knob's default is centre, so a freshly added module is silent. The panel menu still uses the maker's older wording, Splice and Reel, where the panel prints MRK.
